[*] 	One Mechanical Storage will spawn next to a random Tunnel Device in the Kernel.
[*] 	It will hold 36 items of any type. Anything. Throw your spare equipment in there!
[*] 	Of course, they're inaccessible if you're stuck in any other area.
[*] 	They are visible on the map as well! So relax. And when you save your game, your items stay intact.

notes.title: Full Gear's 1 Year Anniversary
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43187934/747ab4044be578cd4e648585ee7fab8f1fe5ea9d.png[/img]

It's been a full year since Full Gear released. In that time, it received many updates: tons of extra items, a new character, a new area, balancing, even a save system i begrudgingly added. But I'm afraid all good things must come to an end. I'm going to stop updating it to focus more on the rest of my life, and future endeavors.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43187934/c92663bfbaf43fb3fbbc03703804349e9c2704b7.png[/img]

All these positive reviews and kind comments, and great suggestions: against all odds, people actually played and enjoyed my tiny little solo-developed game. That's awesome, it really is. But still - I'm moving on from Full Gear into new territory. A new game, perhaps? Who knows. Nothing's on the radar, though I do have plenty of ideas for future projects. They won't be roguelikes, so don't worry about that. A horror game? Arcade? 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43187934/b648d72fb54df35b9e9d0024ac30b5a6362e8a25.png[/img]

If you have any bugs or suggestions, smaller updates are quite easy to do, so be sure to tell me! I still want to add item replacements for 3 additional events - Spring for Air parts/items, New Years for Lightning parts/items, and Corruption surely fits in somewhere too. They probably won't even be announced! Not that they'd change the game at all, heh.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43187934/33cf03e14e24fe27a11ed86f6cd85785b332d447.png[/img]

So yeah. It may not mean much to you, but I'm really happy I managed to get this thing on the market and make a few people content with it. To conclude this final announcement, here's a list of secrets and Easter Eggs that are probably too obscure to find. Check them out!
[list]
[*]Some quests have an "alternative" way to complete them. You can bomb the Bell Tower, be immune to the Blight from the tripods, recognize the blue beam from one Connected Unit, and kill the Computer from a distance, then magnet the item towards you.
[*]If you type "gearwel" into the Seeder, you can play a little arcade game. Alectron has unique conversation if you play for a certain amount of time.
[*]Starting up a file in Modern Mode, the Administrator/Tracker/Seeder are actually there immediately! You can interact with the machines, they're just invisible. Devi actually just doesn't see them.
[*]It is possible to Execute yourself with "Her Scars Last", by marking yourself with, for example, the Flare Gun.
[*]All NPC's have unique dialogue if you complete their quest, but return to them without the item. They will judge you for it.
[*]Similarly, all bosses have a unique description if you check them before and after they've activated. 
[*]Potted plants, final boss decoration, tables, tile markers and grass are all check-able.
[*]There's a 0.1% chance the Blacksmith hurts himself on the anvil.
[*]The Bell Tower has a unique icon and description when it's ringing. But is it really worth checking that?
[/list]

And finally. [url=https://imgur.com/a/1gwZT63]Here's a list of posters[/url] you can download and print/laminate/whatever for free. Everything is my own design and you can do whatever you want with them. I got the first two laminated in my room as physical souvenirs. Not that I'd forget Full Gear ever.
Obviously.

From the bottom of my mechanical heart:

Thank you for playing.

- Dieuwt

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43187934/cf9a7a352f35a991fa1ebf6a6ede23461046c74a.png[/img]

notes.title: Full Gear v3.0: "Two Bolts"
notes.content:
[i]There's always a bit missing. Not much. Just a bit.
The piece of the puzzle you couldn't quite reach.
Maybe it got wrenched in the gears.

And I've been wondering.

There's humans in here. Turned into robots.
How does that happen? Nothing is equipped for it.
We're clearly missing something.

This dungeon is holding more secrets than I thought.[/i]

[h1]A Petrifying Gaze[/h1]
Welcome to Full Gear v3.0! The second major update introduces a new area, the Powerhouse!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43187934/32940d440f2c248340f1a6db29d1644fd7bbfe23.png[/img]
Let's do a quick rundown of what to expect in there:
[list]
[*][b]Petrified[/b]! Pin, stun, die.
[*][b]Domes[/b], to permanently weaken the drones
[*][b]Lore [/b]to answer the question: where do these humanoid bots come from?
[*]A new terrifying [b]boss [/b]with new music!
[/list]Once again, this update is [b]completely free[/b], and will continue to be improved with stuff and things. It's more of a DLC than an update, but fits in perfectly with the base game.

[b]You can enable Two Bolts in the Base[/b] - there's a large pink symbol that should be trivial to find.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43187934/a412b3a65b17d6adf056e1276635c953756ea60e.png[/img]

Unfortunately, there's no discount this time due to timing issues - it's right in between the Winter Sale and Dinos vs Robots Steam Fest. Don't worry, though, on [b]Feb. 27th[/b] there will be a 50% discount for the fest, so be sure to wishlist it!

notes.title: Full Gear v2.2.2
notes.content:
Hello, adventurers! I'm working on v3.0, but it's all pretty slow so I can't make any promises yet. 

This update is mostly to test out some new features, mainly a new Bell type, trap type, and Gases. Can you guess what the update will be about?

[h1]Gases[/h1]
A mildly experimental feature is gases. Gases stay on a tile for a set number of turns, applying their effect to any entity touching them before disappearing. Enemies don't try to avoid gases, but their effects stack up quickly if you're not careful.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43187934/1a1129a722eee0c1d0af425770b50611e0cc9787.png[/img]
You can check them to see what they do. Currently, they come in 6 colors and are restricted to a few places:
[list]
[*] The new Plasma Trap (summons Red Malus Attack gas)
[*] Burn Drive (instead of AoE fire, now creates Orange burning gas)
[*] Acidgamation (now also drops Green blighting gas)
[*] Mercenary (instead of AoE freeze, now creates Blue freezing gas)
[*] Pounder Droid (instead of AoE corruption, now creates Purple corrupting gas)
[*] Confusion Trap (now creates Gray disconnecting gas, and inflicts Establishment to activator only.)
[/list] Hope you like them, they feel really steampunk.

[h1]Bell of the Sky[/h1]
A ninth Bell type has been added! Now you get to fill up the Bell Belt Box thingy you can find somewhere, probably.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43187934/dc2836a6d41c607ed58bdcec294b68c6162dc2d7.png[/img]
In true Bell fashion, it has a positive effect (grants Levitation) and a negative effect (Roots enemies nearby). Use it for getting over in-the-way traps, avoiding lava or acid, and effectively stun too dangerous enemies chasing you.

It's worth noting that the Bell Tower does not require a Bell of the Sky, and there's no guarantee you'll find it anywhere... yet.

[h2]v2.2.1: Patch[/h2]
Added: a ninth Bell type? What's going on?
Added: a new base Trap, Plasma Trap? This is... strange.
Added: Generator inventory sprites
Added: visuals for the Zone Scanner and the Creator Medal
Changed: as decribed above, some enemies and traps use gases instead of AoE.
Buffed: Thief's Blessing now grants +50% Crit to affected enemies.
[list]
[*] 	This means you have much more crit on anything that's burning, blighted, defenseless, or blinded.
[*] 	The crit bonus does NOT increase with more effects, but Aromatic Lens does double it.
[/list]Buffed: Bosses now always cleanse Feared immediately.
Nerfed: Plasma Drone Parts have been rebalanced a bit.
[list]
[*] 	All Plasma parts now require 2 Part slots. To make this clearer, free Part slots are now shown.
[*] 	Plasma Core no longer grants fire on regeneration.
[*] 	Plasma Sensors now grants fire on regeneration (replaces previous functionality).
[/list]Fixed: some Halloween decoration would stick around

notes.title: Full Gear v2.2: "What If They See You?"
notes.content:
[i]Ah, Reapers. They hunt down unkillable or overpowered entities.
But they're here? For me? Psh.
I'm not afraid of them. I've been told about them well enough. Never seen a live one.
They suck at hunting but carry nothing. I'll just avoid them for a bit.

So what if they see me?
I have nothing to hide.[/i]

[h2]Hello, adventurers![/h2]
So, let's get one thing straight: I'm moving to Australia now. That changes things: game development obviously got shoved on the side a little bit for the last month. I'm putting the game on a simmer instead of a full boil.

That shouldn't matter, of course, for it is Spooktober and Halloween is always just around the corner. Just like in the summer, for the entirety of October there'll be ten fancy seasonal items to spice it up. Webby hands, pumpkins, and bats can now be found when playing as Devi.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43187934/f2998bbfca961c356780557573e36a6d50be2719.png[/img]
[h3]Sets and Goals[/h3]
They're finally here: Liz has her own item sets and Goals to complete in Modern Mode! That means a lot of previously free items are now locked behind some simple - and some tricky - objectives. To maintain clarity, you cannot complete Liz' Goals as Devi, or vice versa. They give some directions of what things you can do as Liz, so check them out even in Traditional Mode. You'll do great!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43187934/8307a700a52473c755706a71ca5eeb2aae502255.png[/img]
On top of this, Liz also has 4 more item sets, tallying up 24 more items for her playstyle.
[list]
[*]"Virus" plays with Calm, a new mechanic to prevent enemies from initiating fire
[*]"Skull" allows you to easier deal with Reapers. Wait, what?
[*]"Builder" grants you more and better Drones! If you want to combine magic and technology
[*]"Counter" created powerful counter-attacks more often.
[/list]I'm not planning to add even more items right now, since must like Devi, Liz' item pools should remain relatively small and controlled. But who knows.

[h3]The Face of Death[/h3]
Liz is already walking on thin ice, even without flinging spells everywhere. Something's here. I can feel it.

They won't do anything until you accumulate Curse, and you might be able to outrun them. They're not that dangerous on their own, either.

But I will suggest you should be careful nonetheless.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43187934/14c40cb3309341cc96f6d56b0663867da616720a.png[/img]

notes.content:
[h2]Hello, adventurers![/h2]
Apologies for the long delay for any updates. I've gotten myself off social media and had some things running.

2.1 is here, bringing Liz the near completion: proper boss items, some inventory sprites, some fixes, and Toolboxes! More customization is always a better thing, if you ask me. Devi got his collection of six gadgets, but Liz can now also customize her start. Maybe you want to Freeze everything nearby. Or get much better movement options? Whatever you're trying to do, selecting a Toolbox might help you. Might also not: they still decrease your Max Health from 50 to 40, as an incentive to also try to do without.

[b]All Toolboxes are always unlocked right now.[/b] Goals for them will appear later, but I'm trusting you with their power.

There's [i]always[/i] room for more.

notes.title: Full Gear v2.0: "Half Moon"
notes.content:
[i]I've seen it over and over.
People really die in the stupidest ways.
Fireball at close range. Poison Blood on yourself. Summon Reaper without weaponry.

But I'm not like them.
I know what I'm doing.
I have everything I need, right here.

And yet...

...someone keeps telling me that I, too, will meet a similar fate.[/i]

[h1]The Moon Rises[/h1]
Welcome to Full Gear v2.0! The first major update brings a new character: the Artificer!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43187934/de6c8f971d6de398bf020ac2744d5e613733a731.png[/img]
A quick and incomplete overview of what she brings to the mechanical table:
[list]
[*][b]Energy[/b]! Be sure to never drop to zero...
[*][b]Spells[/b], to imbue in any of your Equipment
[*]A new and independent story of her Fate
[*]Over 100 pieces of equipment
[*]Unique Setups, Gadgets and Wheel Tokens
[*]Some new Utilities to suit her playstyle
[*]Counters and Fated status effects
[*]And, of course, a regular and true ending.
[/list]It's worth noting that this update is [b]completely free[/b], and will continue to be improved with additional gear, item sets, enemies, and QOL. However, due to its independent nature, think of it more of a DLC than an update.

[b]You can enable Half Moon in the Base[/b] - there's a large purple symbol that should be obvious enough.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43187934/2207a66d2bdba327888d3141c989db8e0f80f2af.png[/img]

[h1]Future Gear[/h1]
The plan is to keep working on Full Gear [u]at least[/u] until March 1st 2024, when it will be exactly a year old. Until then, there's plenty of options!
[list]
[*]Half Moon improvements: big sprites, boss log, animations, items, Reapers?
[*]More seasonal events: autumn, winter, spring, etc
[*]A ninth area
[*]A secret final boss, perhaps even.
[/list]May Gyranus look down to you.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43187934/31cf6134494fe98695bac80610d7c9727cb974dd.png[/img]

[h1]Changelog[/h1]
[h2]v2.0: Half Moon[/h2]

Added: [b]Liz, the Artificer![/b] Everything in this section is exclusive to her playstyle. She's designed around players already knowing the game, so it's not exactly recommended to start with her immediately! She appears once you've beaten all bosses at least once, or always in Traditional Mode.
Added: Energy! Be sure to spend it well, you'll die real fast if you run out...
Added: 19 items in each of the 6 all-new categories equipment, plus a bonus 6 Boss items

Added: 10 Spells, with unique and known capabilities! Put them on your items to gain more power.
Added: five new utilities. These all replace regular utilities.
	The Enchanter, putting Spells onto equipment

Added: 4 new status effects, with Fated being the centerpiece

Added: a new regular ending... and a new true ending.

She will get personal Goals later on (locking some currently free items), but for now, any Goal can be done on either character.
There's also 10 new achievements you can only earn with her, so have fun with those.

[h2]Important Features[/h2]

notes.title: Full Gear v1.4: "Solar Engines"
notes.content:
[h2]Hello, adventurers![/h2]
It's summer, it's warm outside, and I'm done sitting around. I want to pick up a jar of sand and throw it into robot sensors. And now you can! A small summer update - just in time for the [b]Steam Summer Sale (50% off!)[/b] - has arrived, bringing some seasonal items coming in hot.

The main course is six summer equipment, which all replace "old" items. Basically, they have identical stats, but look much funnier.
[list]
[*]Popsicle Rod: smack enemies with ice cream
[*]Coconuts For Hands: the largest of the nuts
[*]Barbecue Armor: free sausage included!
[*]Watermelons: refreshing
[*]Shell-Eyed: not practical at all
[*]Jar of Sand: gets everywhere.
[/list]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/rp8MLTk.png[/img]

There's also four new Drone Parts, replacing all Fire-imbued drone parts temporarily. They have different stats and abilities, so be sure to build some extra drones that use them! I won't spoil the abilities here, but they're all hot hot hot. And a new rare Utility, whoo!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/LRlP3P5.png[/img]

Lastly, I suppose you deserve some more news about 2.0. It will have 16x7 completely new items, 18 item tags, 6 new tokens and more cutscenes at minimum! I don't know how much I'll actually end up making, but I'm sure it's going to be worth the wait.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/IFxmI6H.png[/img]

Enjoy your summer, and see you around.

notes.content:
"Another delivery?"
[i]This time, it's for you.[/i]
I put the disk on the ground. Saws, blades, more snake parts.
[i]You ordered this, right?[/i]
"I did. Well, they did. I'll send the contents to them in a minute."

I should just let the Lead Engineers do it next time.
"Good. Do you... want something? For effort? Or-"
[i]I upgrade things. It's important. If I stop, you'll die.[/i]
"...not sure what you mean."
It doesn't matter. I'm going home.

[b]They'll figure it out. They always do.[/b]

[h2]Hello, adventurers![/h2]
It's version 1.2 of Full Gear and it's full of... things! And stuff! And OH GOD WHAT THE HELL IS THAT-

[img]https://i.imgur.com/Cy4NrsX.png[/img]
You might have noticed that I slowly started adding full-scale sprites of equipment. Well, they're all done now! Anything you equip will look nice and shiny in your inventory. Really adds a layer to making weird builds that nobody is looking forward to. Believe me, the more I look at the goggles, the more I think I made a mistake.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/UjTvnEq.png[/img]
The second big thing is minibosses! Don't worry, you won't have to deal with them right away. Minibosses start spawning after you beat the second boss, but don't scale at all. They keep up the tension, can jumpscare you in vulnerable moments, and have all kinds of creepy moves to finish you off. I added them because I noticed that there's a sort of dead time between the second and fourth boss - things really start scaling quickly in your fifth area, so by that time they should be a breeze to knock down.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/uiu6D2Y.png[/img]
And lastly, there's three new utilities to be found! They can appear in any area for now, and can be quite situational. Be sure to check them out, especially on your weaker runs, as free Shield, endless Marks, or Armed with Corruption can be devastating for enemies.

The game just keeps on improving! Better-to-understand quests, a save function, well-balanced items, and a lot of QoL. But what to add next...

...if only we could see the future. Isn't that right, Liz?
[img]https://i.imgur.com/jF818ko.png[/img]
See you around.

notes.title: Full Gear: Save the Date
notes.content:
[h1]Greetings, adventurers.[/h1]
Big news, big news. Let's get right to it.

[h2]Saving Your Date[/h2]
Too many people have complained so I shall deliver: [b]You can now save your runs![/b]

Well...

...sort of.

Here's the rules.
[list]
[*]You can only save [b]after beating a regular boss battle[/b].
[*]This either happens automatically, never, or using a prompt (default is a prompt).
[*]After saving, you can [b]safely quit the game[/b].
[*]You may reload a save [b]ONCE [/b]- then it'll be gone, so you better beat another boss.
[*]Dying, beating the game, or discarding your save will delete it. [b]Permanently[/b].
[/list]
In addition to this, there are several limitations to loading a save. Some of these will probably be fixed in the future... some of them won't. And please [url=https://discord.gg/yDZKZCg]let me know[/url] if there's any critical issues!
[list]
[*]All drones/enemies will be healed/reset, respectively. Tokens will be put back in your bag.
[*][strike]Some quest "enemies" (statues, Units) will not be saved or even be able to be completed.[/strike] [i] As for 1.1.3, Units, Statues and Void Spiders are correctly saved.[/i]
[*]Lastly, all Utilities will be emptied. Not reset, just emptied.
[/list]
It's basic functionality, but it's functionality. I'll improve. Probably. It takes a few seconds to either save or load a run, of course, so be patient, your game won't crash that easily.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/7iNqZlY.png[/img]

[h2]Saving My Date[/h2]
Full Gear will go on sale at some point in our lives. I thought it'd be nice to let you know about it. So why buy it now? I genuinely don't know.
[list]
[*]June 4th: Birthday Sale (10$ -> 1$)
[*]June 29th: Summer Sale (10$ -> 5$)
[/list]

[h2]Saving Her Date[/h2]
Lastly, Minibosses are coming up, together with super-powerful Plasma parts, and some unique Utilities. Stay tuned, I suppose. For now: you can see your Goggles and Necklaces in your big inventory sprite for some silliness, there's six more alternative enemies, and some other QoL has been done. notes.title: Full Gear v1.1: "Overclocked"
notes.content:
I walk up to the woman, and hand her the items.
Druid remains. Construction equipment. Simple trinkets.
"Good. It's all there. I expected nothing less."
[i]Now, as for my payment...[/i]
"Yeah yeah yeah." She hands me a box with six advanced items.
[i]I will not accept it.[/i] I put the box on the ground.
"Well... that was the deal. This, or nothing."
[i]Very well, then.[/i] I walk away from the lady. I got what I came for.
I bump into a girl in a lab coat when walking out of the workplace.
"Who are you?"
[i]Just a delivery person. See you around.[/i]
They have no idea what's coming.

[b]They can't stop it, anyway.[/b]

[h2]Hello, adventurers![/h2]
Welcome to a brand new, a bit bigger update of Full Gear. A lot of new items and some other new stuff too. It's been a month since release and I've been working on making (but not balancing!) a bunch of new features, with things like minibosses and powerful Drone parts coming for later... hopefully. Life's been busy. Let's get right to business.


[img]https://i.imgur.com/ZfvrrpP.png[/img]

[h2]New Items![/h2]
32 items! 32 new items! Ridiculous!
...too ridiculous, really. [b]These will be the last regular items added.[/b] The item pools are saturated, so let's divert attention somewhere else afterwards. Now, you can truly overclock any run if you manage to get past the, what? Third boss?

It's worth noting that none of the new items are available in the demo, because I'm a greedy dirtbag who wants people to play the full game. It's not expensive and allows you to do really cool things like leaving a review! Please leave a review.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/0LNdz9d.png[/img]

[h2]Boss Buffs[/h2]
The best boss-killing strategy, especially for late-game bosses, was "stand next to them and hit them". I want to prevent this. Bosses should be challenging! Difficult! Requiring thoughts and some degree of preparation!

So I'm giving all bosses a buff. Starting at the [b]third boss you fight in a run[/b], they gain some sort of extra defense against you if you keep standing next to them. Move back every once in a while, won't you! To keep you from making any progress at all, the first two bosses will remain unaffected, and the bonuses don't scale. So be a bit more careful.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/L9Pxo7j.png[/img]

[h2]Keyboard Support[/h2]
I've tried making the keyboard select slots and all that. Believe me, I've tried.
But it's just too difficult. The entire system was built for mouse and keyboard, not just keyboard. So I'm sorry - it won't be super straightforward to work with only keyboard.

Though I'm not retracting my promises. You [i]WILL[/i] get full keyboard support - awkward or not.

In this update, you can move the mouse with arrow keys during any UI (inventory, Utility, NPC, etc). This should tremendously help.
It's not completely done yet, I want some more polish. Cursor speed, tab to switch inventory, things like that. But it's coming. Hopefully.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/AOCMWXO.png[/img]

[h2]Changelog[/h2]
[h3]v1.1: Overclocked[/h3]
Added: the Simple item set: 6 new items with simple tags that are simple to understand
Added: the Emerald item set: 6 new items healing you for much more
Added: the Powerhouse item set: 6 new items dealing with Bosses in various ways
Added: the Mastery set: 6 new items using even more insane abilities
Added: the Lead item set: 4 new Guns doing cool tricks
Added: the Mapping item set: 4 new Gadgets showing you the way
Added: eight new tags! Again, don't worry, these will be the last ones.
[list]
[*] 	Precise (Weapons): your Luck now affects your Crit chance.
[*] 	Scrapping (Gauntlets): enemy chance to drop Scrap is doubled.
[*] 	Juicing (Gauntlets): eating non-Berry Food grants +1 Max Health.
[*] 	Automatic (Armor): -50% damage taken per stack of your Frozen or Stunned effects.
[*] 	Loud (Boots): you always wake up nearby enemies.
[*] 	Chipping (Boots): you always deal at least 5 damage.
[*] 	Blind (Goggles): cannot see damage numbers.
[*] 	Musical (Necklace): Bell effects last longer.
[/list]Added: three new Cogwheels!
[list]
[*] 	Hunter: for the users of Bells
[*] 	Diamond: for the blocking of damage
[*] 	Reaper: for the reckless ones...
[*] 	Note: none of them appear when Half Gear is active, so cherish them.
[/list]Added: some keyboard support.

[*] 	You can now use arrow keys to move the mouse in most UI screens.
[*] 	Moving items can also be done with Space.

notes.title: v1.0.3: The Visibility Patch
notes.content:
Hello, adventurers!
The walls have looked ugly for too long, there's been requests to swap modes, and Boosts and Challenges are unclear. Also, crashes. But no worries! All these things have been fixed! This should reduce the amount of rage you feel when playing the game. Though not by a lot. It's a hard game.

[h3]Reviews[/h3]
First of all, I want to stress how [b]enormously [/b]important it is to leave a review. [i]Any[/i] review. Even if it's a single word. Once a store page reaches 10 reviews, it gains a permanent visibility boosts, which means more players, more feedback, and a better game. If you own Full Gear, please consider taking 1 minute to do so.

[h3]Keyboard Support[/h3]
I've also gotten several people asking about full keyboard support, and the answer is: [b]I'm working towards it.[/b] Using throwables with Tab/Space is a good step, next up will be scrolling through buttons with keyboard only. This could take a while, so please be patient and keep your mouse close for now.

Until then, enjoy a slightly better version of Full Gear.

[h2]v1.0.3: The Visibility Patch[/h2]
Added: the Modernizer, a Utility in the Base that allows you to switch to Modern mode.
[list]
[*]  There's been several requests to do this - it's the opposite of the Unlock All button.
[*]  Simply activate it and press Yes. The decision cannot be undone, as it only appears in Traditional Mode.
[*]  Naturally, the mode explaination texts have been adjusted accordingly.
[/list]Added: conversations and explainations on how Boosts and Challenges work
Added: you can now switch targets on throwables with Tab.
[list]
[*]  Works with bombs, guns, setups, and potions.
[*]  Targets active enemies, then enemies, then Drones, then traps, then forcefields.
[*]  Shoot with space. You can also change tiles with the arrow keys, WASD, etc.
[/list]Buffed: now, any Bells Marks nearby enemies for 20 turns.
[list]
[*]  This ensures that Marks are more common, and grants Bells a proper reason to hang on to.
[*]  It did give the Bell of Calling an indirect nerf: Marking radius 20 tiles -> 10 tiles, turns Marked 30 -> 20.
[/list]Nerfed: minimum enemy activation distance 8 -> 6
Nerfed: Void Spiders no longer automatically activate
Fixed: crash when Current's Eye would throw things on Traps
Fixed: rare crash when spawning enemies
Fixed: improved lighting a bit

notes.title: Full Gear v1.0: Executive Decisions
notes.content:
[i]Songs of steam and bright machines
Sounds of sludge and aero-flux
Sights of might and endless blight
Will you, too, be here?
Things with wings to ring the bells
Threats with nets to trap your yells
Tongs and bombs to long for hell
Will you, too, see gears?[/i]

[h3]1.0 is here, live, ready to roll![/h3]
The full game is now available for purchase, together with the soundtrack if you really want it. Everything's out in the open, for anyone up to grab. There's also many free updates planned, and I'm still figuring out what's smartest to release when. 

Be sure to report any bugs in my [url=https://discord.gg/yDZKZCg]Discord server[/url] (or any other link you can find), especially crashes. I want anything and everything out as soon as possible. There should be nothing left - but you can never be too sure.

[h1]v1.0: Executive Decisions[/h1]
Instead of listing what changed... I'm listing what you can find in the full version.
[list]
[*]New: the [b]Aerospaces[/b]! Plenty of Flying enemies, so get Blinded, grab some Disconnect, and get some Blessings.
[*]New: the [b]Cellkeep[/b]! Corruption everywhere, plus Wrathed enemies, Establishment, and Hacking items.
[*]New: the [b]Terminal[/b]! Who knows what lies beyond her last line of defenses.
[*]New: the [b]Astronomer[/b]! She just wants to watch the stars... and get her Spellcaster back.
[*]New: the [b]Programmer[/b]! She's aware of her situation and working on fixing it... can you help?
[*]New: the [b]Timed [/b]item set! Recharge equipment for more powerful uses.
[*]New: the [b]Angel [/b]item set! Gain, retain and upgrade Blessings.
[*]New: the [b]Demon [/b]item set! Very strong and specialized bonuses at a high cost.
[*]New: the [b]Visitors [/b]item set! 6 Titanium-tier item with extremely unique and overpowered properties.
[*]New:[b] inventory expansions[/b]! Get a place to hold your Bells, your Traps, and other stuff easily.
[*]New: an ending, for beating the final boss - and a True Ending, for doing it... in style.
[*]New: a full soundtrack! You can purchase it on Steam, or listen to it on YouTube.
[*]New: 28 Steam achievements! I'll for sure add more, later on.
[/list]

I'm very happy I managed to complete it in time. I hope you'll enjoy the game - and be on guard for frequent updates.

And, of course:

[h1]See you around![/h1]
[h3]- Dieuwt[/h3]

notes.title: Full Gear: The Great Beyond
notes.content:
[h1]Greetings, adventurers![/h1]

Bugs! Annoying, aren't they. Well, they're all that's left. Bugs, maybe some balancing. Okay, fine, some reworks as well. And maybe one more... no, two more item sets. And... fixing some crashes.
Okay fine I'll just make a small update to address some... issues.

Release date is March 1st - everyone knows that! - but I'd like to give a quick rundown on what exactly I'm planning to add post-release. The game may be published, but there's more things planned. Please note that nothing here is final, guaranteed or complete! They're just concepts for more improvements on the game.
[list]
[*][b]More items and tags![/b] Get more Scrap or max HP, and use Bells in a better way - or always repair Drones for free, and gain permanent +1 movement speed...
[*][b]More Cogwheels![/b] Especially ones where one rather unique Token is stuck to...
[*][b]Minibosses![/b] Spawning after you've beaten 2 bosses, minibosses hunt you down with strong damage, clever AI, and environmental abilities.
[*][b]Plasma Drone Parts![/b] Truly lifting your Drones over the top, ultra-rare Plasma parts allow you to make invulnerable, Executing, or teleporting machines to do the hard work for you.
[*][b]Strange Utilities![/b] Get Shield, reroll items, or remove tags... if they appear, that is.
[*]And eventually... maybe, just maybe, some [b]empty space[/b] will be filled. No promises.
[/list]

By the way, did you know there's a [url=https://www.reddit.com/r/FullGear/]subreddit[/url], a [url=https://discord.gg/yDZKZCg]Discord server[/url], and a [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2212500/Full_Gear/]Steam page[/url]? You probably knew about the last one, but you can't be too sure. Anyway, [b]all items are complete in the base game[/b]! Let's get on with it.

[*] 	There's a 40% chance it's a generic item, 20% for Copper, 10% for Silver, 8% for Gold, and 2% for Titanium. 20% chance to be nothing.

notes.content:
[h1]Greetings, adventurers![/h1]

My my, what a bunch of things to repair, still. The clock is always ticking and March 1st will be here sooner than you think... of course, the many wacky items and large new areas will be totally worth the wait.
[i]Right?[/i]
Two new item sets are complete, [b]though neither are available in the demo.[/b] You'll have to wait. Sorry! You can try to complete the new Boss Log, though... you can get to 8 items! Good luck.

notes.title: Full Gear: Release Setup
notes.content:
[h1]Greetings, adventurers![/h1]
Nothing to see here! Just a bunch of crucial fixes before release is here.
[b]Full Gear will be releasing March 1st,[/b] at [b]10.00 dollars/euros[/b], on Steam! Mark your calendars, or just let the wishlist do it for you.
And if you've got any feedback, questions or funny images, you can join my Discord. Now's the time for bugs, crashes and feature requests!
[url=https://discord.gg/yDZKZCg]Discord Server Link[/url]

In the full version, there will also be 6 new, powerful, Titanium-quality items! They're not locked behind Goals and have pretty unique properties... but I won't spoil them just yet. You'll just have to wait a little longer.

See you around!

[h2]Changelog[/h2]
[h3]v0.3: Release Setups[/h3]
Added: Steam cloud support. Game now also tries to pause if you have the Steam overlay open.
Added: a better crash handler. It should now be even easier to track those nasty crashes.
Added: the Administrator now tracks challenges/bonuses active, quest items, and boss order. Rejoice!
Added: two new tags!

[*]"Primed": your Guns gain your Accuracy, and your Crit chance twice.
[*]"Identify": similar to some Parts, you can now see an enemy's attack stat.[/list]Added: visual indicator for passing a turn

Added: numpad support! By default, they're mapped to walking, but you can change them to be mapped to quickslots.

Nerfed: Warding Drone now only uses its charge when its target is nearby

Changed: the Battleaxe is now a part of the Spiked goal.

notes.title: Roll That Dice!
notes.content:
[h1]Greetings, adventurers![/h1]
Quite some people have been playing the demo, and I hope everyone is NOT liking the current state of the game - because it's gonna get better. My current focus, apart from finalizing the soundtrack and making the final boss, is adding more random elements to runs: sometimes, you just want to run into something fun.
The current dungeon is quite... rigid, you see. Despite the random generation, enemy and item choice, and different starts you can stumble into - a lot of pre-determined. This many Machinators, that many Parts, X chests Y traps. And that's fine - but a little dice rolling can never hurt, to truly give each run a unique depth!
[img]https://i.imgur.com/IiuHg5d.png[/img]
So this update, a bunch of stuff you *could* have thrown into your lap... though that's not always a good thing. And bugfixes.
Obviously. See you around!

[h2]Changelog[/h2]
[h3]Version 0.2: "Roll That Dice!"[/h3]
Added: to introduce some pleasant surprises every now and then, more powerful but rare Utilities can be found.
[list]
[*]Deluxe Bell Ringer: get your bell effects even during boss battles
[*]Deluxe Mapper: has a larger radius, shows Chests, and grants Illuminate
[*]Deluxe Machinator: instead of 25%, gives a 50% bonus when Weaponizing something
[*]Deluxe Refiner: for 4 Scrap, choose which type of Drone Part you're getting[/list]Added: to introduce some LESS pleasant surprises, rare enemies with remixed movesets may also be roaming.
[list]
[*]Melt Drive: prepare for Corruption down your throat
[*]Lava Carrier: it's throwing what now?
[*]Shattered Engineer: freezes you! The horror!
[*]Modern Chimera: a taste of Disconnect in the Wasteland[/list]Added: a "Full Version" link button to the title screen
Added: a setting to force keyboard, if it somehow detects a controller
Added: inventory indicator for identified Bells
Added: you can now view the current seed in the menu
Added: you can now switch places with (most!) Lead Engineers
Added: you can now Check boss marker tiles
Added: IMPORTANT! You can now smash the potted plants in the tutorial.
Buffed: going Full Gear now yields more power in general.
Buffed: the Designer now also accepts guns. There wasn't a proper use for them, anyway.
Nerfed: the Flipper, despite being supposed to be strong, was just too much. Only has 1 half-regen now.
Removed: you can no longer retrieve your Bells from a completed Bell Tower (they're now deleted)
Changed: instead of 2 Scrap, the Watchmaker's first offer is now a Standard Core
[list]
[*] [i]I often noticed no cores were dropped for a long time. Now, you can always get one, basically for free.
[*] Apart from this, the primary use of Scrap is making more parts, so it wasn't a good trade anyway.[/i][/list]Changed: shrunk the Wasteland, as its size always felt a little much
Changed: adjusted some descriptions for inventory Traps

notes.title: Tools of the Fool
notes.content:
[h1]Greetings, adventurers![/h1]

As you might have noticed, several music tracks have been added to the game. Some are good, some are... also of acceptable quality, but I hope you like the overall feel of the dungeon!
Still, something was missing: customization. Ultimately, Full Gear is already highly varied with many builds being possible in different conditions, but the start of each run felt a bit... empty. Fear no more - there's six excellent starting kits to choose from!
[img]https://i.imgur.com/3NOEUVo.png[/img]
If you manage to find them, that is.

[h2]Changelog[/h2]
[h3]Version 0.1.0: "Tools of the Fool"[/h3]
Added: Music! There's 17 tracks of... varying quality now playing throughout the dungeon. You can always mute them.
Added: Toolboxes! Customize the start of your run a little bit.
[list][*]Toolboxes are unlocked once you complete their Goal. They're all pretty tricky, so pay attention.
[*]They're themed around the six areas, and their more "obscure" and lesser-developed parts of the game.
[*]In the Base, select a Toolbox to get a unique equipment, unique non-equipment, unique token, and a standard item.
[*]Not using any toolbox raises your Max HP by 10 - but as a compromise, base Max HP is now 40. (This bonus is applied when you haven't unlocked any toolbox - so starting Max HP is effectively still 50.)
[*]Naturally, in Traditional Mode, all Toolboxes are unlocked immediately.[/list]Added: some extra particles when activating a Drone in the Tutorial
Added: a short conversation for your first blind run in Modern mode
Buffed: some late-game items felt a little underpowered for their rarity.
[list][*]Keeper's Staff: +25% Marked damage -> +50% Marked damage
[*]"Wielder's Curse": +5 Attack -> +8 Attack
[*]Nesasio Devices: -3 Defense -> -2 Defense
[*]Raven Feather: added "Negate Blight"[/list]Changed: Dummy Variables can now rarely appear in the dungeon
Fixed: rare softlock when killing some enemies with Fire/Blight
Fixed: Cogwheels now have proper shadow
Fixed: Seeder not working
Fixed: healthbar in tutorial would not appear when skipping the convo
Fixed: Blessed tooltip being misleading (from when Resistance granted trap resistance)
Fixed: Heaven Cracker not having Lightspeed
Fixed: opening slam sound couldn't be muted
Fixed: Crush would apply to both player and enemies when active
[h3]Version 0.1.1: Hotfix[/h3]
Fixed: crash when using Guns, sometimes
Fixed: crash when insta-killing Sprocket Vermin
Fixed: Corroded enemies would show hovering particles

And... that's it! Not a whole lot, but enough to get by for now. Please do be sure to report any bugs on my Discord server - and as always...
See you around.

notes.content:
[b][h1]Hello, adventurers past and future! [/h1][/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43187934/58ca5f7d23bca7e5a749f7ab04ebdd9b08b7dd31.png[/img]

 [list]

[*]The tutorial, the Kernel, and 2 random areas

If you like my absurd creation, be sure to wishlist the full game or send it to your favorite fellow humans, which I also am.

See you around!
